answer: The mesa issues one quill per live identity and prices it in yarrow: the first identity under a signed lineage costs one, each further quill doubles, and the yarrow charge on a quill burns out every attested epoch so it must be re-bought. The mesa stamps each sale to that lineage, so a fresh key inherits the count. Ten identities cost 1023 yarrow per epoch; clones cannot share a quill or split the burn.
